thesis: This episode argues that the AI era is fundamentally reshaping software economics, where dominant systems players like Nvidia and cloud giants like Google are evolving beyond pure semiconductors or browsers into integrated rack-level solutions and data portals. It suggests that companies successfully transitioning to cloud models or leveraging AI reasoning are proving their viability, while those failing to execute face significant risks.
